facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for the loan of his mithril shirt.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, which he lent for the Dwarven mine trip.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril shirt (on loan) over his leather armor, greatly improving his protection and halving damage from magic weapons and spells.
Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral for the mithril shirt, and keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use each night while the party is away; both can be reclaimed when the deal is settled.
The Dwarven mine entrance is sealed by a natural-looking cave-in, blocking access to the metal for Warwick; it can be dug through, and Dunk has already begun breaking into it.
Warwick believed seven dwarves were working metal at the Dwarven mine, but it is caved in, their cabin burnt and Grimny dead. Is there still metal to be had there?
